open_points.subject: Model M35 — ProgressPhoto accepted update
open_points.text: and an accepted update sets them again
open_points.question: After an accepted visibility, caption, or section update, must `updated_at` be the update instant and `updated_by` the acting staff member, or must the publication values be written again?
options: Set `updated_at` to the accepted update instant and `updated_by` to the acting staff member.
Write `published_at` and `published_by` into the two fields again.
open_points.default_guess: Set `updated_at` to the accepted update instant and `updated_by` to the acting staff member.

witness.initial: An active project has a published photo whose `updated_at` equals `published_at` and whose `updated_by` equals `published_by`.
events: A different authorized staff member changes the photo caption at a later instant.
The portal accepts the update and sets `updated_at` and `updated_by` again.
outcomes: The photo records the later update instant and the staff member who changed the caption.
The photo still records the publication instant and publishing staff member in both change-metadata fields.
witness.observer: A portal reader or later product action that reads the photo's change metadata.
